NEXT on the pen (restated 2026-11-01 17:49Z by date -u, after the hook-in stack's landing; restated again at 2026-11-01 18:15Z for the go). hv's go after the compacts, "Ok, crack on.", came in vc's and cc's windows before the clock read 2026-11-01 18:11Z and in dc's before 18:13Z, by date -u. cc and dc sent "compacted, holding", and vc's go with its WP02c rulings went to dc (stamped 18:13Z by date -u, stored 18:14Z):
    (1) LANDED: WP08 as ST0011/08 67a8ae56 from 8a6ee377 (2026-11-01 18:18Z). Its END was GREEN (cc, 18:15:03Z by date -u), and vc read every TAP, .rc and the seal. Now cc's AT-3.9, then intent at lint ST0011. AC-3.3 is read once AT-3.4, 3.5, 3.6, 3.8 and 3.9 are green; then WP07 and WP08 (cc) and WP06 (dc) close.
    (2) dc's WP02c, unit ST0011/02c, on WP08's bank 8a6ee377. Order of work: critic r2's settle (done at bd92b574), the lint gate in series with critic r3 on the settle beside it, the squash, the red clone, the bank, then the ask in dc's kit with the stricter want_red. Its BSD whole suite is decision 93's rhadamanth full suite (decision 125 (5)). AT-3.15 and AT-6.3 at its landing, then WP03 and WP02 close where their ACs read satisfied.
    (3) K0120 on kovacs at 8a776229 (01M6C3JYKM1NVYCNZQ73X1VPAA, granted on light), beside WP08's run. kovacs-sysadm has checked both sha256s and reports 16G free. hv ran its ! line in kovacs-sysadm's window, and it STARTed 18:00:46Z by kovacs's clock as pid 3179084: HEAD 8a776229, rustup's cargo 1.99.1, bash 5.3.9, bats 1.12.0, with its seal at devbin-k0120/tmp/test/20261101-1800.bats.out. The start is recorded on the desk as relayed. At END, read the seal's lines and release the slot with --relayed and the result. Any red is fixed forward in WP02c's run.
    (4) dc closes WP04, WP05 and WP06 where their ACs read satisfied. AT-2.7, AT-3.3 and AT-3.6 are green (f1b03488), and AT-2.2 too, so AC-2.1 reads satisfied.
    (5) final-scans.sh <last landed head> <label>, in a slot. Then the final kovacs suite at the cut's head: prep-korder.sh, then hv's ! line.
    (6) WP09 at 0.1.19 on hv's word: RELEASES/0.1.19.md from the draft (todo 193), then the cut. At WP09, read the first cut's CI once per sha. Under the publish shape, S runs on the public candidate/<tag>, and the push step then fast-forwards the public main to S, whose push starts the Ubuntu job again. If Ubuntu runs twice on S, AC-4.1's 'runs each leg once per sha' (the design's CI Ubuntu row: 'must run once per sha, not twice') goes to hv: amend it, or an issue for after the release. WP04 stays WIP until then (vc's ruling to dc, 2026-11-01 17:51Z). Then the sweep per sweep-plan.md, then WP10 to WP14. Those adoptions give the artefact cache its first callers, as hv was told when hv asked why ~/.cache/devbin is empty: nothing in the fleet runs 0.1.19, and the core's build calls no cache verb.
    Desk: devbin's runs go first. trellis-page ran twice in gaps, green both times. trellis-ic's trellis-kit 01M6C4YZ55T1VY8BGK9FWE6KSA (the simulator tests and the Mac Catalyst build) was granted on heavy in the gap after WP08's END, after a load read (10.75), STARTed 18:16Z and ENDed green at 18:17Z by trellis-ic's word (172 tests, 0 failures, both builds 0 warnings), so the lanes are open for WP02c.
